model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between trajectory length and the variable γ for Monte Carlo (MC), showing three distinct categories. The x-axis is labeled "γ", with a linear scale, ranging from 0.86 to 1.00, and tick labels at intervals of 0.02. The y-axis is labeled "Trajectory length", also on a linear scale, spanning from 10 to 22, with tick labels at intervals of 2. The plot displays three lines representing "Unsuccessful" (red), "All" (blue), and "Successful" (green) trajectories, each depicted with dashed lines and error bars. The "Unsuccessful" line starts at approximately 16.4 at γ = 0.855 and increases to around 20.5 at γ = 1.00. The "All" line begins at about 15.4 at γ = 0.855 and rises to approximately 19.2 at γ = 1.00. The "Successful" line commences at roughly 10.5 at γ = 0.855, reaching around 15.5 at γ = 1.00. All three lines exhibit an overall increasing trend across the range of γ, with the "Successful" line showing a more pronounced increase between γ = 0.98 and γ = 1.00.
